goal: Improve every primary application page, prioritizing material selection through completed virtual try-on.

scope.priorUncommittedFeatures: Preserved material ZIP/brief, selected history export, history navigation, recent searches and similar references.

workflowChanges: Catalog selection has a visible review action and direct exact-ID continuation to try-on; basket and catalog share the same recipe builder with original background preserved by default.
Reference picker has a persistent selected-count/Done footer. Output size and ratio are visible near Generate. Missing person/clothing brings keyboard focus to the required action.
Tool pages use compact left-aligned titles and provider help. Generate has a task-specific heading; editor has an explicit heading; mobile basket is directly reachable.
ID photo, portrait, themed and couple tools put upload before configuration and generation. Travel has a photo-upload shortcut before the map; Enhance model/license information is expandable.

Shared upload/replacement uses native keyboard-operable buttons and stable input IDs; generation blocks image changes. Photo removal remains visible with 44px targets in batch, travel and couple tools; multiplayer actions use roomier rows.
Couple chooser and drop support adding people individually without replacing earlier inputs; order/capacity/cancelled input and inflight behavior are tested.

Result download/share/edit actions precede parameters; secondary image tools are explicit disclosures. Format labels have unique IDs. Batch cards no longer offer a misleading clear-all action per image.
Travel selection colors reuse readable shared brand states; faint nested labels and low-contrast success buttons/model links are corrected.
Multi-person template centering adjusts only its horizontal list; arriving at the page no longer scrolls past the heading/upload.

browser.cases: All page identities, WCAG2A/AA serious/critical checks and overflow; exact-ID catalog-to-tryon mocked generation; keyboard native upload/replacement; visible touch removal; incremental couple selection; independent multi-result format labels; preexisting full regression.

waivers.reason: Tailwind emits this shared focus utility. Home and tool styles provide explicit 2px focus-visible outlines for interactive controls; keyboard browser regressions verify the real menus, dialogs and uploads.
This is the single React application mount. Its child routes provide their own shared wrap and section boundaries; the mount itself has no visual layout.

This is the interactive try-on form, not a marketing hero. Uploading person/clothing/pose inputs, opening optional workspace tools and generating are distinct required task actions. Advanced actions are collapsed; real keyboard and pointer tests cover the visible controls.

The try-on route is an application form with selected references and retained generation results. Natural document scrolling keeps the complete workflow reachable on small screens and with expanded settings. A fixed marketing-screen height previously caused nested-scroll and hidden-action problems.

This application workspace deliberately scrolls as one document. Its form, reference board, optional settings and retained results must remain reachable at zoom and mobile widths; restricting it to a single marketing fold would recreate the usability issue the user asked to fix.
